decision.rationale: TXN-008127 is a charge of 1809.90 EUR at SALTMARSH JOURNEYS on card CRD-000003. It was posted on 2026-08-11 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, which is 76 days later and within the 120-day time limit. Its authorisation, AUTH-008315, was an online payment (entry mode ECOMMERCE) that passed 3-D Secure (AUTHENTICATED). The card security code matched (CVV MATCH), there was no fraud flag, and the payment was APPROVED. Under the policy, an online payment confirmed through 3-D Secure with no fraud flag counts as made by the cardholder, so the dispute is declined. A matching security code also supports this. The card has no earlier transactions at this merchant: the disputed charge is the only one, so past purchases neither support nor weaken the decision. The cardholder says they did not make the charge, but the authorisation record does not support that.

proposed_actions.reason: The 1809.90 EUR payment to SALTMARSH JOURNEYS was made online. It was confirmed through the bank's 3-D Secure check and the card security code was correct, with no sign of fraud. Under our policy this payment is treated as made by the cardholder.
